symptom: Erreur x464 en champ de bataille : « attempt to perform boolean test on local 'visible' (a secret boolean value) » dans LayoutTypeIcons.
code:
71: -- right edge of the health bar when there is no name. Redone when the name, the frame or a symbol changes.
  72: local TYPE_GAP, NAME_MIN = 1, 45 -- px between symbols; px of name that must stay readable beside them
  73: local function LayoutTypeIcons(pb)
  74:     local list, bar = pb.WLTypeIcons, pb.healthBar
  75:     if not (list and bar) then return end
  76:     -- the symbols live inside the client's aura container: it may refuse some calls on them ("secret aspects"),
  77:     -- so each one goes through pcall and a refusal just leaves that symbol where it is
  78:     local shown, size = {}, 0
  79:     for _, it in ipairs(list) do
  80:         local ok, visible = pcall(it.IsVisible, it)
  81:         if ok and visible then
  82:             shown[#shown + 1] = it
  83:             local okw, w = pcall(it.GetWidth, it)
  84:             if okw and type(w) == "number" and w > 0 then size = w end
  85:         end
  86:     end
  87:     local n = #shown
  88:     local total = n * (size + TYPE_GAP)
  89:     local name = pb.Name
  90:     local cfg = name and name.config
  91:     local hasName = name and name.Enabled ~= false and cfg and cfg.Points and name:IsShown() and true or false
  92:     local old = pb.WLNameShift or { 0, 0 }
  93:     local sl, sr, mode = 0, 0, "bar"
  94:     if hasName and n > 0 then
  95:         local w = name:GetWidth()
  96:         local textW = name:GetStringWidth() or 0
  97:         mode, sl, sr = "before", total, 0
  98:         -- the box width without my own shift; unknown before the first layout: then the symbols stay first
  99:         if w and w > 0 and (w + old[1] + old[2]) - total < math.min(textW, NAME_MIN) then mode, sl, sr = "after", 0, total end
 100:     end
 101:     -- nothing changed since the last pass: nothing to anchor again
 102:     local sig = mode .. ":" .. n .. ":" .. size .. ":" .. sl .. ":" .. sr
 103:     if pb.WLTypeSig == sig then return end
 104:     pb.WLTypeSig = sig
 105:     -- the name box: its left anchor is pushed right, its right anchor left
 106:     if hasName and (old[1] ~= sl or old[2] ~= sr) then
 107:         pb.WLNameShift = { sl, sr }
 108:         local es = name:GetEffectiveScale()
 109:         for j = 1, cfg.ActivePoints do
 110:             local pc = cfg.Points[j]
fix:
diff --git a/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Modules/NativeAuras.lua b/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Modules/NativeAuras.lua
index 3886be5..13c59d6 100644
--- a/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Modules/NativeAuras.lua
+++ b/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Modules/NativeAuras.lua
@@ -76,11 +76,23 @@ local function LayoutTypeIcons(pb)
 	-- the symbols live inside the client's aura container: it may refuse some calls on them ("secret aspects"),
 	-- so each one goes through pcall and a refusal just leaves that symbol where it is
-	local shown, size = {}, 0
+	-- The container's frames may answer "hidden / shown" with a secret value (it cannot even be tested): then
+	-- the symbol slots the container made are all reserved, shown or not, so the name never runs under one.
+	local shown, size, hidden = {}, 0, false
 	for _, it in ipairs(list) do
 		local ok, visible = pcall(it.IsVisible, it)
-		if ok and visible then
+		local secret = ok and issecretvalue and issecretvalue(visible)
+		if secret then hidden = true end
+		if ok and (secret or visible) then
 			shown[#shown + 1] = it
 			local okw, w = pcall(it.GetWidth, it)
-			if okw and type(w) == "number" and w > 0 then size = w end
+			if okw and not (issecretvalue and issecretvalue(w)) and type(w) == "number" and w > 0 then size = w end
+		end
+	end
+	if hidden then -- the ones whose answer was a plain "hidden" are reserved too
+		shown = {}
+		for _, it in ipairs(list) do
+			shown[#shown + 1] = it
+			local okw, w = pcall(it.GetWidth, it)
+			if okw and not (issecretvalue and issecretvalue(w)) and type(w) == "number" and w > 0 then size = w end
 		end
 	end
